name: Las Ventanas Al Paraiso
positioning: Las Ventanas al Paraiso, A Rosewood Resort: a Los Cabos resort of suites, villas and residences looking out over the Sea of Cortez
best_for: Families and friends traveling together who want two- or three-bedroom suites
Couples planning a proposal, anniversary or romantic escape
Travelers who want a villa with its own kitchen and infinity pool

facts.text: The resort looks out over the Sea of Cortez.
Sea Grill serves freshly grilled fare, ceviche and shellfish, and traditional Mexican dishes.
Alebrije is an Italian dining experience by the sea.
La Cava, the resort's wine room, is available for private dining.
The villas have an adobe fireplace, a full kitchen, large living and dining areas, an infinity pool and a Jacuzzi bathtub.
Two- and three-bedroom suites are designed for families and friends traveling together.
The one- to three-bedroom residences and rooftop penthouses are designed for longer stays.
The resort arranges golf and tennis.
The resort offers curated romantic experiences for proposals, anniversaries and romantic escapes.

highlights.text: La Botica is a Prohibition Era-inspired speakeasy bar evoking the 1920s.
The Tequila & Ceviche Bar serves ceviche, Mexican-Japanese sushi fusion and tequila.
The Ty Warner Mansion is a 28,000 square foot oceanfront villa.
Junior suites feature handcarving, intricate tiling, artwork and an adobe fireplace, and each opens to a private patio or rooftop terrace.
Arbol serves coastal cuisine highlighting seafood, with delicate Asian influences and spices from India and the East.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the resort's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife options within walking distance.
